title: Iced Brewed Black Decaffeinated Tea Sweetened with Low‑Calorie Sweetener

content.title: About
content.content: This iced brewed black tea is decaffeinated and pre‑sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener. It retains the characteristic aroma and flavor of black tea while lacking the stimulating effect of caffeine, making it suitable for evening consumption.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea undergoes full oxidation, giving it a deep color and robust taste.
Decaffeination is usually performed by water or CO₂ methods, preserving most beneficial compounds.
Sweetening with low‑calorie agents such as stevia or erythritol reduces calories without added sugar.
Iced brewed tea is often served over ice, providing a refreshing beverage in warm weather.
Ready‑to‑drink technology allows the product to retain flavor and freshness for several months.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Black tea is rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Flavonoids may improve vascular function and help lower blood pressure.

items.title: Caffeine‑free
items.content: The lack of caffeine makes the drink safe for individuals sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Low‑calorie sweetening allows a sweet taste without excess calories.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Iced tea contributes to daily fluid intake.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tea components.

items.title: Tannin content
items.content: Tannins can reduce iron absorption when consumed in large amounts.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Certain low‑calorie sweeteners may cause digestive discomfort in some people.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve the iced tea chilled, with or without ice. It can be added to cocktails, smoothies, or used as a base for fruit‑infused drinks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
